subject: Console walkthrough + API enablement — scheduling and prep

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Console walkthrough + API enablement — scheduling and prep

Hi Amelia —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a 60–90 minute onboarding session that covers:
- Quick console walkthrough (live demo of model deployment and monitoring)
- API enablement (temporary key creation, sample request flows, pagination/streaming)
- Q&A and next steps for production onboarding

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue, Mar 23 — 10:00–11:30 AM PT
- Wed, Mar 24 — 2:00–3:30 PM PT
- Thu, Mar 25 — 11:00 AM–12:30 PM PT

I attached a short agenda and a prework checklist to help your team prepare (training_agenda_v1.pdf, prework_checklist.txt). Could you confirm which slot works best or suggest alternatives? Also let me know if you want the session to lean more heavily on console vs API examples.

Attendees from our side: myself (AE), Monica Patel (solutions engineer — console deep dive), Logan Wright (platform specialist — networking & infra).

Thanks — looking forward to getting FastRetail onboarded smoothly.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Thanks — everything looks great. We can do Tue, Mar 23, but would it be possible to start earlier at 8:30 AM PT? Our engineering lead (Ethan) has an overlapping commitment later in the day and prefers morning slots. We expect to have 4 folks from engineering + 2 product managers.

Also, can you confirm whether it's feasible to show a short example with our dataset? I can attach a small anonymized sample (CSV) if that helps with the demo.

Appreciate it —
Amelia

amelia@fastretail.co
